scope: Partial formalization of the basin-density paper. Checks the complete abstract Banach-valued two-scale averaging lemma and its rate; irrationality of the specified scale ratio; unconditional uniform packing and reciprocal tails for all finite positive distinct shortcut paths, including the actual parity and entropy recurrence; absolute correction-product bounds and convergence along positive injective infinite orbits; actual countable geometric-word arithmetic mass, its finite Syracuse residue-law identification and explicit prefix-sum formula, and upper, lower, and maximum mass bounds; and elementary raw-to-shortcut and divisible-by-three target bridges. The infinite stationary probability measure on the 3-adic integers has not been identified in Lean with these finite laws. First-passage arithmetic inputs are separately checked by external replay artifacts, not this scope. Basin-density existence, weighted Green limits, canonical-limit identification, and the additional Mazur theorem interfaces are not certified by this report. No Collatz conjecture proof is claimed.
